_comment: Short capture-only run for the fixed-ratio RX sampling plan (decision/ADR-002-bidirectional-dshot.md) - just enough real replies (~4000-4800 at DSHOT300's ~500-600/s) across two throttle levels to tally period_cycles per candidate rx_speed via scripts/tally_period_cycles.py. Not a regression scenario - no 'expect' thresholds, single bidirectional channel (channel 1, the best-characterized one), deliberately short so each of several candidate rx_speed values can be flashed and captured quickly in one sitting.
